name: iniBuilds TriStar Airliner (L-1011-500)

flaps._comment: L-1011-family flap labels use 0, 4, 10, 22, 33, and 42. Flap and gear speed values are provisional compatibility values pending redistributable public-source or vendor verification. Normal takeoff: 4 or 10. Normal landing: 33 or 42 (42 = FULL for short/wet runways; 33 = normal). The iniBuilds FAQ confirms AoA mode auto-engages at Flaps 33.

engines._comment: 3 Rolls-Royce RB211 engines. 2 wing-pylon mounted, 1 centre-mounted via S-duct through fin. EPR-rated (not N1). The iniBuilds simulation uses a detailed EPR logic model.

lvars._comment: This profile uses standard Microsoft A-vars only. A bounded gauge-subscription path supplies supplemental engine values that are not present in Flight Fabric's shared frame; no iniBuilds-private LVAR telemetry is enabled.

autopilot._comment: The documented AFCS key events use SimConnect, but this profile does not use generic AUTOPILOT MASTER or mode SimVars as AFCS-state readbacks. Keep those fields unavailable until a vendor-documented and independently verified source is available.

spoilers._comment: TriStar Direct Lift Control (DLC) uses spoiler panels during normal approach, so the generic SimConnect spoiler value can include DLC or roll-spoiler movement rather than only speedbrake-handle state. Keep spoiler UI/scoring state unavailable until a dedicated handle or autospoiler source is verified.

controls._comment: Official iniBuilds TriStar keybind FAQs publish standard SimConnect Event IDs for AFCS selector steps, AFCS mode buttons, and exterior lights. The trusted aircraft-specific adapter exposes only the documented selector decrement/increment events and fixed light actions. Selector and AFCS mode events are delivery-acknowledged pulses because iniBuilds does not publish reliable remote selector or mode-state readbacks; INI_* action LVAR references remain inactive.

autopilot._comment: These AFCS events are vendor-documented but not yet verified in-sim. They are exposed as momentary pulses, never inferred on/off state. AP_AIRSPEED_HOLD is the TriStar AT button, and TOGGLE_WATER_RUDDER is repurposed by iniBuilds as INS course capture/tracking.

meta.notes: iniBuilds L-1011-500 TriStar Airliner for MSFS 2024. The dedicated page exposes 41 bounded standard-SimVar reads covering exterior lights, configuration, three-engine EPR/N1/N2/fuel-flow/reverser data, fuel, weight, and pressurization. Twenty-six source-backed light and selector actions include 14 readback-confirmed fixed light intents and 12 vendor-documented selector step pulses. Unsupported direct selector inputs and unreliable generic selector readbacks are excluded. AFCS mode pulses remain available separately without claiming mode state. Generic AP/mode booleans and spoiler state stay excluded because they do not represent the required AFCS and speedbrake-handle semantics.

knownIssues: Flap and gear speed values are provisional and need redistributable public-source or vendor verification before promotion.

TriStar spoiler telemetry is suppressed because DLC uses spoiler panels during normal approach and generic SimConnect spoiler state can report DLC/roll spoiler deflection rather than actual speedbrake handle deployment.

The 41 bounded standard-SimVar reads require live L-1011-500 validation. Twelve supplemental engine fields use the gauge-subscription bridge because those standard A-vars are not part of Flight Fabric's shared frame.

The 26 aircraft-specific light and selector actions use official iniBuilds event IDs and remain untested pending in-sim verification. Light intents require fresh readback; selector steps report delivery acknowledgement only.
Logo OFF/ON uses the vendor-published toggle event only after a fresh preflight readback; stale or unavailable logo state blocks the write instead of guessing.

AFCS and course selector controls expose only the decrement/increment events documented by iniBuilds. The cockpit windows remain the source of truth because the vendor does not publish reliable remote selector readbacks or direct target events.
Active AFCS mode controls are documented by the official iniBuilds keybind FAQ but remain untested and do not claim engaged/disengaged state.
Generic SimConnect AP master/mode readback is suppressed because it can remain off while the custom TriStar AFCS is actually engaged.
The dedicated page intentionally excludes generic spoiler/speedbrake state because DLC can move spoiler panels independently of speedbrake-handle intent.
The cited vendor material does not define a complete TriStar custom telemetry interface, so the profile does not subscribe custom LVAR readbacks.
Deep flight-engineer systems and reverser writes remain unavailable because iniBuilds does not publish equivalent stable mappings with independent readback.

_comment: iniBuilds L-1011-500 TriStar Airliner for MSFS 2024. The adapter exposes 41 bounded standard-SimVar reads, 14 readback-confirmed light intents, and 12 delivery-acknowledged selector steps without generic AFCS selector/mode readbacks, ambiguous spoiler state, vendor-private telemetry, or speculative deep-system writes. All active selector and AFCS pulse events are sourced from official iniBuilds documentation.
